posts.name: Sumedhik Bandyopadhyay
posts.cooked:
Untitled picture1264×389 17.1 KB

This is a “ppa” question from the VM machine .I;ve been using the command

echo "(cal "$month" 2023 > "${month}.txt" 2> error.txt) || (touch "${month}.txt" && cal "$month" 2023  2> error.txt)" >calendar.sh

to try and solve the above problem. Trying some other variations as well, but the question won’t let up. Please suggest some alternatives. Thank you

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Will not give away the solution, but a few pointers.

  1. You are using variables inside double quotes, what do you think happens to those? Print out the script you are making using cat calendar.sh and verify is it really what you expected it to be? Suggestion: you have learnt editors in week 2, use them.
  2. What does the second clause do? Do you really need it?

Try to break down what the question is asking and solve it part by part. The benefit of solving them in the VM is that you can run any command here and check out how they work, so utilize that to build commands from start part by part instead of directly writing a big piece of command.

posts.name: Sumedhik Bandyopadhyay
posts.cooked: Thank you, using the nano text editor to write a script over several lines was certainly helpful!!
